import json, sys, hashlib
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
rd = sys.argv[1]
t = ET.parse(f"{rd}/junit.xml").getroot()
suites = t.findall("testsuite") if t.tag == "testsuites" else [t]
cases = []
for s in suites:
    for c in s.findall("testcase"):
        st = "passed"
        if c.find("failure") is not None: st = "failed"
        elif c.find("error") is not None: st = "error"
        elif c.find("skipped") is not None: st = "skipped"
        cases.append({"classname": c.get("classname"), "name": c.get("name"), "status": st,
                      "skip_reason": (c.find("skipped").get("message") if st == "skipped" else None)})
cnt = {}
for c in cases: cnt[c["status"]] = cnt.get(c["status"], 0) + 1
obj5 = [c for c in cases if "obj5" in c["name"]]
raw = {"run_id": "RUN-PFDR-011cd0-tests", "tests": len(cases), "counts": cnt,
       "G3_prime": {"all_non_skipped_pass": cnt.get("failed", 0) == 0 and cnt.get("error", 0) == 0,
                    "T_OBJ5_cases": obj5,
                    "T_OBJ5_demonstrates_undercount_on_prefix_code": all(c["status"] == "passed" for c in obj5) and len(obj5) == 2},
       "skips": sorted({c["skip_reason"] for c in cases if c["status"] == "skipped"}),
       "junit_sha256": hashlib.sha256(open(f"{rd}/junit.xml", "rb").read()).hexdigest(),
       "certificate": {"instances_claimed": 0, "note": "a test run claims no solve"},
       "cases": cases}
json.dump(raw, open(f"{rd}/raw-result.json", "w"), indent=1)
print(json.dumps({k: raw[k] for k in ("tests", "counts")} | {"G3_prime": {k: v for k, v in raw["G3_prime"].items() if k != "T_OBJ5_cases"}}))
